title: EGPn2 1 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: EGPn2 1 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: EGPn2 1 peanut is a peanut variety. About 104 days to harvest, 1.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: EGPn2 1 is a registered peanut variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1995 as NSIC 1995 Pn 03. It takes about 104 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.81 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 1.81 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

EGPn2 1 peanut takes about 104 days from sowing to harvest. That is about the average of the 26 peanut varieties with a day count, 101.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.81 t/ha matches the average of its group, 1.85. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit peanut fields most often: [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 43.6 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed holds 18.67 percent crude protein.
Where and when to plant EGPn2 1 peanut
Mani needs loose, well drained soil to fill its pods. Pick a variety by seed size for your buyer, and one rated against rust and leaf spot for the wet season.
